Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves (A/D sideways, W/S vertical); arrow keys FIRE projectiles in that direction (never move the player) — tears travel slowly, so align then fire. E drops a bomb at feet (bomb count decrements immediately, countdown sparks visible ~1s). Q and Space showed no effect — don't retry. Movement is fine-grained (~0.06–0.09 room-width per 0.4–1.0s); blocked by rocks/barrels — step laterally instead of re-pressing. Death = empty grey heart outlines + bloodied sprite; don't confuse an enemy's X-eyed face with the corpse.

TECH X / FIRING: Small white rectangle at the player's face = Tech X goggles being worn (not a carried item); stepping onto the white pill pickup grants it. Pill sits at the two-poop room's top-hatch landing and RESPAWNS on room re-entry (renewable power-up); goggles persist across rooms. Firing normally spawns a lingering (~1s) laser ring that grinds overlapping targets and destroyed both poop piles in the two-poop room. Ring spawn offset is inconsistent — reposition rather than spray. Ring trails on rocks/props look like red cracks; they are NOT damage. Opens gray metal chests when fired at. No effect on: '$' coins, golden keyhole door, shelled/armored hoppers, red-lidded chests, spike-ringed red chest, dark-room blobs/spiders, white spike rings, decorative wall cracks, bomb-headed enemies. UNRESOLVED: point-blank firing left at the torch-room chest (from ~0.05 room-width away) produced NO visible ring and did not open it — uncertain whether firing fails at very close range or is simply blocked by the rock ring. One short Up tap earlier showed no ring at all.

COINS/PICKUPS: real coins are small golden '$' rounds collected only by near-exact walking overlap; counter updates one observation late. Blue orbs = soul hearts (+2 blue over 1 red). Heart at full hearts → +1 bomb. Decorative gold flickers change no counter. Two-poop room: BOTH piles destroyed this run gave NO coin even after ~2.5s wait — coin drops are unreliable/possibly randomized; don't count on them.

CHESTS: gray metal chests open by contact or firing; drop heart and/or bomb; re-close on re-entry. Torch-room central gray chest sits inside a tight triangular rock ring; firing is blocked by the ring (now also failed point-blank). Bombing works: a blast cleared the upper ring rocks and opened a lane toward the chest. Self-damage: 1.2s retreat was NOT enough — still lost 1 heart (blast radius ~2 tiles); retreat 2s+ or leave the room. White slit/mark on a fired-at chest: open vs locked UNRESOLVED.

BOMBS: E places at feet; clears rock rings/pockets but does nothing to white spike rings or decorative cracks. CONFIRMED (two runs): a bomb blast spawned a blue soul-heart orb nearby — treat blasts as a possible soul-heart source but never stand close.

HAZARDS: dark chest room black spiders/blobs are melee chasers, laser ineffective; room costs hearts and yields nothing without keys — AVOID. Rock-field white round-faced hoppers are extremely lethal: they warp/teleport (seen arriving at doorways), self-ring with spiky gray rocks, leave green splatter clouds and damaging green orbs, and fill the room with drifting black dot projectiles; one visit cost 3 hearts→1. Corner torches damage on contact (a diagonal down-left path past the bottom-right torch was walked safely). Hits cost 1–3 hearts. Stay 2+ tiles clear. Blue flies exist (seen in two-poop room): they hover, drift, and FIRED blue tears at the player — treat as ranged threats; their damage amount is unconfirmed.

UNCERTAIN: in the two-poop room a second pale player-like figure appeared briefly beside me carrying the same white rectangle, then vanished; movement test showed the surviving figure was me (player). Hypothesis only: a transient mimic/decoy enemy — do not assume lookalikes are friendly.

TRANSITIONS (observed): gold trapdoors need centered sustained S (torch-room trapdoor at x≈0.50 works from just above it — confirmed this run). Crown hatches need precise x-center and sustained W from ~0.1–0.2 room-height below; standing ON the frame blocks the warp (step back, re-center, re-approach). Trapezoid doorways need sustained walking plus fairly precise centering. Confirmed routes: tutorial TOP trapezoid ↔ rock-field; tutorial BOTTOM trapezoid ↔ torch room; tutorial RIGHT-wall doorway (y~0.47, near-exact vertical centering) ↔ dark chest room; torch room TOP alcove (x~0.50) ↔ tutorial; torch room BOTTOM gold trapdoor (x≈0.50) ↔ two-poop room; two-poop room TOP crown hatch ↔ torch room (confirmed both ways); dark chest room LEFT-wall brown doorway ↔ tutorial; rock-field TOP exit → TNT/barrel room (NOT tutorial); TNT room TOP trapezoid → pink-enemy rock room.

MAP: Tutorial (top+bottom trapezoids, right doorway y~0.47). Below → torch room (gray chest in rock ring, 4 corner torches incl. bottom-right ~x0.75/y~0.65–0.74, poop pile, roaming bomb-headed enemy, top alcove, bottom trapdoor x≈0.50; clear lanes run down the left column x≈0.31 and along the bottom y≈0.67). Below → two-poop room (two destructible piles flanking a rock, Tech X pill at hatch landing, only exit top hatch, state resets on re-entry). Above tutorial → rock-field (golden keyhole door left wall ~x0.19,y~0.49; hoppers; bottom exit apparently blocked; top exit → TNT room). TNT room: TNT barrels line the left wall and block lanes (passable one row higher); two gray chests wedged among them (~y0.30, ~y0.63); red-lidded brown barrel beside the lower chest. Pink-enemy rock room: two pink fat enemies (presumed chasers — guess), poop pile with blue flies, rocks, gray chest-like object at left wall. Right of tutorial → dark chest room.

UNRESOLVED: what opens the golden keyhole door and red-lidded/spiked chests (no key ever seen; HUD always 00); whether the HUD icon slot (~0.92,0.14) does anything; whether rock-field bottom exit works (guesses: doors lock while enemies live, exit is arrival-only, or the dark post blocks it); meaning of the white mark on a fired-at chest; damage of blue flies; source of keys/health drops; whether chest contents and coin drops are randomized per run; whether lasers can ever open a chest through it
